card.title: Importing a spreadsheet
card.sub: Bring in the companies and people you already have, from one CSV file.
card.foot: Demo mode: every company, person and email here is made up, and nothing is saved.

scenes.caption: Bring in the companies and people you already have, from one CSV file.
Open Import. Fill in a spreadsheet, one line per person, or per company, and save it as CSV.
Start from the template: it has every column, including where we met. Only the company is required, and empty cells stay empty: nothing is guessed.

scenes.caption: Paste it, or choose the file. Here, four lines: two people at a new company, one person at a company we already have, and a line with no company.

do.click: main button:has-text("Show what will be written")

scenes.caption: Show what will be written says what it will add: 1 new company, 3 new people, 1 contact logged as an action.
And any line it cannot use, with the reason: line 5 has no company, so it is skipped.
Example Ventures was already here, matched by its domain: its person is added, and nothing already there is changed.
Press Write it. The new company is on the lead board, with its stage, owner, last contact and next step from the sheet.

card.title: One rule
card.sub: Enter only people you have a reason to keep in touch with, and only what they shared with you.
